# Color Sets

```{r}
color_SampleType <- hue_pal()(17)

# using " unique(S_metadata$FruitType)" 
color_FruitType <- c("BL" = "purple4", "CH" = "red4","na" = "grey",  "ST" = "red2")

# using cold colors for batch 1 sites, warm for batch 2
color_FruitSite <- c("na" ="grey", "FIN" = "skyblue", "IST" = "blue2" ,  "LOM" = "skyblue4", "MIL" = "deepskyblue", "VAR" = "dodgerblue", "THU" = "coral2")

color_LifeStage <- c("na" ="grey",  "Mother" = "darkolivegreen4", "Larva"= "darkolivegreen2", "Pupa" = "darkorange2", "PupalCase"="#8B4500", "Daughter" ="goldenrod2")

color_Pop <- c("na" = "grey", "CEC"="#C1FFC1", "FRA" = "seagreen3" )
```

# Load data

```{r}
ps_rare_16S <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "16S_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))
ps_rare_ITS <- readRDS(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "ITS_TM1&2_ps_rare.rds"))

metadata <- data.table::fread(file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "2_RarefyData", "TM1&2_metadata.tsv"),sep="\t",header=TRUE)
```

# 1. Prepare data

```{r}
########
# 16S #
########
ps_rare_16S_bin = phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_rare_16S, function(x) 1*(x>0)) # counts -> presence/absence (binary table)

## Extract metadata
mtd_16S <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_rare_16S_bin))
mtd_16S <- mtd_16S %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = ID_pool)

## Extract taxonomy table
df_taxo_16S = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_16S_bin)) #taxonomy table into dataframe
df_taxo_16S$tax_ID = rownames(df_taxo_16S)

## Extract table with presence/absence
df_reads_16S = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_16S_bin)) #abundance table (binary) into a dataframe
df_reads_16S$tax_ID = rownames(df_reads_16S)
## Merge table with presence/absence and taxonomy
df_wide_16S = dplyr::left_join(df_taxo_16S, df_reads_16S, by = "tax_ID") #merge the two (suppr "Species" column)
df_wide_16S$Species <- NULL

## Remove taxonomy other than Genus
BF_16S <- df_wide_16S[, c(6,8:dim(df_wide_16S)[2])] #subset + genus as row names + sample names as column names + transposematrix
BF_16S$Genus <- make.unique(BF_16S$Genus, sep = "_")
rownames(BF_16S) <- BF_16S$Genus 
BF_16S$Genus <- NULL
#colnames(BF_16S) <- mtd_16S$Sample[match(colnames(BF_16S), mtd_16S$Sample)]
## Transpose matrix
FB_16S <- t(BF_16S)

# Preview
sbm::plotMyMatrix(FB_16S, dimLabels = c('taxon', 'sample') ,
  plotOptions = list(rowNames = TRUE, colNames = TRUE,  legend = TRUE,  legend.position = 'right'))


## Only Life Stage samples
ps_16S_rare_LS <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_16S, LifeStage !="na")
ps_rare_16S_LS_bin = phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_16S_rare_LS, function(x) 1*(x>0)) 

mtd_16S_LS <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_rare_16S_LS_bin))
mtd_16S_LS <- mtd_16S_LS %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = ID_pool)

df_taxo_16S_LS = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_16S_LS_bin)) #taxonomy table into dataframe
df_taxo_16S_LS$tax_ID = rownames(df_taxo_16S_LS)

df_reads_16S_LS = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_16S_LS_bin)) #abundance table (binary) into a dataframe
df_reads_16S_LS$tax_ID = rownames(df_reads_16S_LS)

df_wide_16S_LS = dplyr::left_join(df_taxo_16S_LS, df_reads_16S_LS, by = "tax_ID") #merge the two (suppr "Species" column)
df_wide_16S_LS$Species <- NULL

BF_16S_LS <- df_wide_16S_LS[, c(6,8:dim(df_wide_16S_LS)[2])]
BF_16S_LS$Genus <- make.unique(BF_16S_LS$Genus, sep = "_")
rownames(BF_16S_LS) <- BF_16S_LS$Genus 
BF_16S_LS$Genus <- NULL
FB_16S_LS <- t(BF_16S_LS)

########
# ITS #
########
ps_rare_ITS_bin = transform_sample_counts(ps_rare_ITS, function(x) 1*(x>0))

mtd_ITS <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_rare_ITS_bin))
mtd_ITS <- mtd_ITS %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = ID_pool)

df_taxo_ITS = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_ITS_bin))
df_taxo_ITS$tax_ID = rownames(df_taxo_ITS)

df_reads_ITS = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_ITS_bin))
df_reads_ITS$tax_ID = rownames(df_reads_ITS)

df_wide_ITS = dplyr::left_join(df_taxo_ITS, df_reads_ITS, by = "tax_ID")
df_wide_ITS$Species <- NULL

BF_ITS <- df_wide_ITS[, c(6,8:dim(df_wide_ITS)[2])]
BF_ITS$Genus <- make.unique(BF_ITS$Genus, sep = "_")
rownames(BF_ITS) <- BF_ITS$Genus
BF_ITS$Genus <- NULL
#colnames(BF_MPC3_ITS) <- mtd_MPC3_ITS$Sample[match(colnames(BF_MPC3_ITS), mtd_MPC3_ITS$Sample_Old)]
FB_ITS <- t(BF_ITS)

# Preview
sbm::plotMyMatrix(FB_ITS, dimLabels = c('taxon', 'sample') ,
  plotOptions = list( rowNames = TRUE,  colNames = TRUE,  legend = TRUE,  legend.position = 'right'))

## Only Life Stage samples
ps_ITS_rare_LS <- Subset_physeq(ps_rare_ITS, LifeStage !="na")
ps_rare_ITS_LS_bin = phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_ITS_rare_LS, function(x) 1*(x>0)) 

mtd_ITS_LS <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_rare_ITS_LS_bin))
mtd_ITS_LS <- mtd_ITS_LS %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = ID_pool)

df_taxo_ITS_LS = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_ITS_LS_bin)) #taxonomy table into dataframe
df_taxo_ITS_LS$tax_ID = rownames(df_taxo_ITS_LS)

df_reads_ITS_LS = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_ITS_LS_bin)) #abundance table (binary) into a dataframe
df_reads_ITS_LS$tax_ID = rownames(df_reads_ITS_LS)

df_wide_ITS_LS = dplyr::left_join(df_taxo_ITS_LS, df_reads_ITS_LS, by = "tax_ID") #merge the two (suppr "Species" column)
df_wide_ITS_LS$Species <- NULL

BF_ITS_LS <- df_wide_ITS_LS[, c(6,8:dim(df_wide_ITS_LS)[2])]
BF_ITS_LS$Genus <- make.unique(BF_ITS_LS$Genus, sep = "_")
rownames(BF_ITS_LS) <- BF_ITS_LS$Genus 
BF_ITS_LS$Genus <- NULL
FB_ITS_LS <- t(BF_ITS_LS)
```

```{r}

# 16S #

LBM_bernoulli_16S <-  as.matrix(FB_16S) %>%
    sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli')

memb_spl_obs_16S <- LBM_bernoulli_16S$memberships$row
memb_otu_obs_16S <- LBM_bernoulli_16S$memberships$col

LBM_bernoulli_16S$storedModels %>% dplyr::arrange(ICL)

LBM_16S_FruitType <- Order_Matrix_Plot(SBMobject = LBM_bernoulli_16S, BF_mat = BF_16S, mtd = mtd_16S, color_variable = "FruitType", variable_name = "FruitType", modality_string = c("BL", "CH", "na", "ST"), color_string = c("purple4", "red4","grey","red2"))
```

# 3. Alluvial plot

## 16S

### Fruit type

```{r, eval=FALSE}

## Extract rows and columns for the alluvial plot
memb_spl_obs_16S <- LBM_bernoulli_16S$memberships$row
memb_otu_obs_16S <- LBM_bernoulli_16S$memberships$col

# Cluster_Sample
# data for alluvial plot (Freq = Number of samples associated with each line)
dataalluvial_16S_fruits <- as.data.frame(table(
      sample_data(ps_rare_16S_bin)$FruitType,
      memb_spl_obs_16S))

#dataalluvial_16S_fruits <- as.data.frame(table(
#      sample_data(S_ps_rare_16S_bin)$FruitType,
#      memb_spl_obs_16S,
#      sample_data(S_ps_rare_16S_bin)$FruitSite))

# change column names
colnames(dataalluvial_16S_fruits) = c("FruitType", "Gut_bacteria",  "FruitSite", "SampleSize")
colnames(dataalluvial_16S_fruits) = c("FruitType", "Cluster_sample", "SampleSize")

# plot for fruits
Alluvial_16S_Fruits <- dataalluvial_16S_fruits |>
  ggplot(aes(axis1 = FruitType,
             axis2 = Gut_bacteria,
             y = SampleSize)) +
  #ggplot(aes(axis1 = FruitType, axis2 = Cluster_sample, axis3 = FruitSite, y = Freq)) +
   # scale_x_discrete(limits = c("FruitType", "FruitSite", "Cluster_sample"), expand = c(.2, .05)) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("FruitType", "Gut bacteria"), expand = c(.2, .05)) +
  ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(aes(fill = FruitType), alpha = 0.6) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum() +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("BL" = "purple4", "CH" = "red4","na" = "grey",  "ST" = "red2"),
                    guide = "none") +
  ggtitle("16S_Fruits") +
  theme_minimal(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"))
```

## 4. CCA with membership LBM

### 4.1 Functions Ravigné et al. 2022

```{r}

only.F.alt2 <- function(memberships, var1, var2) {
  n <- length(memberships)
  
  modules <-
    lme4::dummy(as.factor(memberships), levelsToKeep = levels(as.factor(memberships)))
  
  one.1 <- vegan::cca(modules ~ var1, na.action = na.omit)
  one.2 <- vegan::cca(modules ~ var2, na.action = na.omit)
  two.1 <- vegan::cca(modules ~ var1 + var2, na.action = na.omit)
  one.1.alone <-
    vegan::cca(modules ~ var1 + Condition(var2), na.action = na.omit)
  one.2.alone <-
    vegan::cca(modules ~ Condition(var1) + var2, na.action = na.omit)
  
  xxx <-
    list(
      one.1,
      one.2,
      two.1,
      one.1.alone,
      one.2.alone)
  
  sapply(1:5, function(x)
    F.computation(xxx[[x]], n))
}

analysis.function.alt2 <- function(incid,memb_obs, var1, var2, configs = NULL){#industrial processing of CCA, two permutations
  n <- dim(incid)[1]
  modules <- lme4::dummy(as.factor(memb_obs), levelsToKeep = levels(as.factor(memb_obs)))
  
  one.1 <- vegan::cca(modules ~ var1, na.action=na.omit)
  one.2 <- vegan::cca(modules ~ var2, na.action=na.omit)
  two.1 <- vegan::cca(modules ~ var1 + var2, na.action=na.omit)
  one.1.alone <- vegan::cca(modules ~ var1 + Condition(var2), na.action=na.omit)
  one.2.alone <- vegan::cca(modules ~ Condition(var1) + var2, na.action=na.omit)
  
  xxx <- list(one.1,one.2,two.1,one.1.alone,one.2.alone)
  
  chi2 <- sapply(1:5, function(x) chi2.computation(xxx[[x]]))
  Forms <- sapply(1:5, function(x) extractTerms(xxx[[x]]))
  F <- sapply(1:5, function(x) F.computation(xxx[[x]],n))
  P <- sapply(1:5, function(x) anova(xxx[[x]],permutations = permute::how(nperm=NPERM-1))$P[1])
  
  if(is.null(configs)) {
    results<-data.frame("Formulas"=Forms,"chi2"=chi2,"F"=F,"P"=P)
    } else {
    depth <- dim(configs)[2]
    all.F <- sapply(1:depth,function(x)
    only.F.alt2(as.vector(configs[,x]),var1,var2))
    #only.F.alt2(as.vector(configs[,x])[[1]],var1,var2))
    all.ecdf <- apply(all.F,1,ecdf)
    P2 <- sapply(1:5,function(x) 1-((all.ecdf[[x]])(F[x])))
    results <- data.frame("Formulas"=Forms,"chi2"=chi2,"F"=F,"P"=P,"P2"=P2)
  }
  results
}

chi2.computation<-function(ccaobj){
ccaobj$CCA$tot.chi
}

extractTerms<-function(model){
paste0(formula(model$terms))[3]
}

F.computation<-function(ccaobj,size){
	if(is.null(ccaobj)){
		0
	}
	else{
		ccaobj$CCA$tot.chi*(size-ccaobj$CA$rank-nulltozero(ccaobj$pCCA$rank))/(ccaobj$CA$tot.chi*ccaobj$CCA$qrank)
	}
}

nulltozero<-function(x){
	if(is.null(x)){
		x<-0
	}
	x
}
```

### 4.2 Null model

```{r}
NPERM <- 10

sim_list = list()
  
#for each rarefied matrix
  sim_mat <- BF_16S
  #produce NPERM simulated graphs
  netBin.config <-
    simulate(vegan::nullmodel(as.data.frame(sim_mat), "curveball"), nsim = NPERM)

  LBM.config <-
    sapply(1:NPERM, function(i) {
      BF_sim <- netBin.config[, , i]
      FB_sim <- t(BF_sim)
      LBM_sim <-as.matrix(FB_sim) %>%
    sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli',
                         estimOptions = list(plot = T))
       memb_spl_sim <- LBM_sim$memberships$row
    })
```

```{r}
LifeStage_vect_16S <- as.factor(mtd_16S$LifeStage[match(rownames(FB_16S), mtd_16S$Sample)])

    "LifeStage" = as.factor(LifeStage_vect_16S))

varp_16S$part

#CCA with line randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_NULL_16S <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_16S), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_16S, var1=cca_data_16S$FruitType, var2=cca_data_16S$LifeStage, configs = NULL)

#CCA with full randomization
wholenetwork_cca_results_CONFIGS_16S <- analysis.function.alt2(incid=as.data.frame(FB_16S), memb_obs=memb_spl_obs_16S, var1=cca_data_16S$FruitType, var2=cca_data_16S$LifeStage, configs = LBM.config)
```
